title: Reuse a fully retained descriptive prompt pilot without inferring discovery efficacy
statement: The supplied fixed twelve-response, three-case, two-arm retrospective pilot has six starts per arm. Two label-blind scorers give expert versus causal-scaffold means 22/3 versus47/6 and15/2 versus47/6 out of8. This is a descriptive score difference on cued proposed decisions; no proposed action was executed and no discovery-rate, significance, held-out or total-cost advantage is established.

requires: Exact frozen prompts, task packets, assignments, response-only outputs, rubric and both original scoring records
Precollection one-assigned-read amendment and actual late review timing retained
provides: Recoverable complete supplied pilot rather than a23-line summary
Both score decompositions and disagreement retained; direct arithmetic checked against saved results
Separate observed/descriptive claims from causal and scientific-outcome claims
assumptions: Three purposive retrospective cases; twelve starts are not twelve independent scientific problems
Shared ambient instructions and tools; no hard filesystem/context isolation
Scoring is label-blind, not demonstrated condition blindness; one scorer knew generic arms and ceiling effects are substantial
No reroll/completion claims beyond retained scoped source observations; no provider-call authentication by curator
costs: Reported worker totals831935 input,779136 cached input,15564 output including11289 reasoning tokens; do not double-count reasoning
Twelve worker starts are not necessarily twelve provider inference calls; shared cap220words does not equalize compute
Root/Sol preparation and judging excluded; full total cost, attributable money and strict compute parity unknown
contract.units: Three research cases; twelve response starts; six per arm; four0-2 rubric dimensions, maximum8
contract.obstruction: Can inform a better discriminating future study. Does not establish a generally winning prompt, model, allocation method or downstream scientific capability.

evidence.quote: no improvement in Astra's discovery rate has yet been established.

evidence.range_scope: Frozen score and usage aggregation; not downstream discovery outcomes.

body: Frozen method materials, original response/scoring bytes, amendments and source-bound limits are publicly recoverable. Existing A1016 extraction review remains historical at its actual version and does not certify unobserved execution or efficacy.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
